description: MCS251 ISR per-board acceptance ledger (T10). Six frozen states; real-board results are booked per board. A QEMU run against one board's firmware must never be booked as that board's real-hardware PASS.

status_rules.PASS: item executed on the named physical board with the frozen firmware assets and every assertion held
status_rules.FAIL: executed on the physical board and at least one assertion failed
status_rules.NOT_RUN: board available but the item was not attempted
status_rules.MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: executed and the item hit a model/chip capability limit; expectations were never lowered to manufacture PASS
status_rules.BASELINE_MISMATCH: tool/image identity (sha256) or frozen baseline bytes did not match the manifest
status_rules.BLOCKED_NO_BOARD: no physical board provided; this is the initial state of every item

repeated-isr.notes: repeated ISR entries on the same source

integer-state-spx.notes: full 37B integer state plus SPX across save/restore window

helper-ecall-eret.notes: ordinary helper ECALL/ERET from inside the ISR

controlled-two-level.notes: controlled two-level nesting via fixture IP/IPH configuration

default-entry.notes: unregistered legal slot hits the fail-stop default entry

hw-frame-profile.notes: chip-specific hardware frame profile (4B, PSW1/PC order)

reti-ie-ip-timing.notes: hardware timing after RETI/IE/IP writes, booked as an independent item
